settings.colorBlindMode.description: Use blue instead of green for diff additions
settings.colorBlindMode.label: Color-Blind Mode
settings.composer.shape.description: Visual layout of the input editor and status line
settings.composer.shape.label: Composer Shape
settings.composer.tokenRate.description: Show a live generation tok/s readout on the working row, docked right next to the session title. Estimated from streamed deltas and corrected by the provider's billed output count as each message completes.
settings.composer.tokenRate.label: Generation Rate
settings.display.cacheMissMarker.descrip: Show a divider above an assistant turn whose request lost (missed) the prompt cache
settings.display.cacheMissMarker.label: Cache Miss Marker
settings.display.collapseCompacted.descr: Collapse pre-compaction history behind the summary divider on the live transcript; disable to keep the full transcript inline with dividers at each compaction point
settings.display.collapseCompacted.label: Collapse Compacted History
settings.display.hideToolActivity.descri: Hide model-initiated tool calls and results from the transcript
settings.display.hideToolActivity.label: Hide Tool Activity
settings.display.pinnedAgents.descriptio: Pinned live-agent jump list above the editor (off hides it; collapsed shows a few rows with an expander; full lists all)
settings.display.pinnedAgents.label: Pinned Agents
settings.display.pinnedAgents.options.co: Show a few rows with an expander
settings.display.shimmer.label: Shimmer
settings.display.shimmer.options.classic: Soft cosine wave sweeping across the text
settings.display.shimmer.options.kitt.de: Knight Rider 1982 red light bouncing left-right
settings.display.showTokenUsage.descript: Show per-turn token usage on assistant messages
settings.display.showTokenUsage.label: Show Token Usage
settings.display.showTurnTime.descriptio: Show the total prompt-to-yield time (including tool calls) on assistant message usage rows
settings.display.showTurnTime.label: Show Turn Time
settings.display.smoothStreaming.descrip: Reveal assistant text and streamed tool input smoothly while chunks arrive
settings.display.smoothStreaming.label: Smooth Streaming
settings.images.autoResize.description: Resize large images to 2000x2000 max for better model compatibility
settings.images.autoResize.label: Auto-Resize Images
settings.images.blockImages.description: Prevent images from being sent to LLM providers
settings.images.blockImages.label: Block Images
settings.showHardwareCursor.description: Show terminal cursor for IME support
settings.showHardwareCursor.label: Show Hardware Cursor
settings.statusLine.compactThinkingLevel: Show the thinking level as a single icon on the model name instead of a separate ` · <level>` suffix.
settings.statusLine.contextLine.descript: How the line between the left and right segments reflects context usage (box composer only)
settings.statusLine.contextLine.label: Context-Reactive Line
Percentage plus ticks at the speculative and auto-compaction boundaries
Annotated line with the context percentage and window embedded in the gauge
Solid accent line, no context feedback
Used portion in accent color, remainder dimmed
settings.statusLine.preset.label: Status Line Preset
settings.statusLine.preset.options.defau: Model, path, git, context, tokens, cost
Maximum info with Nerd Font icons
settings.statusLine.separator.label: Status Line Separator
settings.statusLine.sessionAccent.descri: Use the session name color for the editor border and status line gap
settings.statusLine.sessionAccent.label: Session Accent
settings.statusLine.showHookStatus.descr: Display hook status messages below the status line
settings.statusLine.showHookStatus.label: Show Hook Status
settings.statusLine.transparent.descript: Use the terminal's default background for the status line instead of the theme's `statusLineBg`. Powerline end caps are dropped because they need a contrasting fill to bridge into the surrounding terminal.
settings.statusLine.transparent.label: Transparent Status Line
settings.symbolPreset.description: Glyph set for icons and symbols (Unicode, Nerd Font, or ASCII)
settings.symbolPreset.label: Symbol Preset
settings.symbolPreset.options.nerd.label: Nerd Font
settings.task.showResolvedModelBadge.des: Display the actual model ID used by each subagent in the task widget status line
settings.terminal.showImages.description: Render images inline in the terminal
settings.terminal.showImages.label: Show Inline Images
settings.terminal.showProgress.descripti: Emit OSC 9;4 indeterminate progress while the agent or context maintenance is running
settings.terminal.showProgress.label: Native Terminal Progress
settings.theme.dark.description: Theme used when the terminal has a dark background
settings.theme.dark.label: Dark Theme
settings.theme.light.description: Theme used when the terminal has a light background
settings.theme.light.label: Light Theme
settings.tui.codexResetFireworks.descrip: Celebrate unscheduled Codex weekly usage resets and newly banked saved resets with a top-third fireworks overlay that remains until Escape
settings.tui.codexResetFireworks.label: Codex Reset Fireworks
settings.tui.hyperlinks.description: Wrap paths and URLs in OSC 8 hyperlinks for terminal-native click-to-open (auto: detect support; off: never; always: unconditional)
settings.tui.hyperlinks.label: Terminal Hyperlinks
settings.tui.imeSafeCursor.label: IME-Safe Prompt Layout
settings.tui.mouse.description: Capture mouse clicks in the main session so live subagent cards and HUD rows focus on click, with a hover highlight on the target. Native text selection becomes Shift+drag and wheel scroll becomes Shift+wheel while on
settings.tui.mouse.label: Mouse Click-to-Focus
settings.tui.reactions.description: Invite the agent to react to your message with an emoji badge on its bubble
settings.tui.reactions.label: Agent Reactions
settings.tui.renderMermaid.description: Render Mermaid fenced code blocks as ASCII diagrams
settings.tui.renderMermaid.label: Render Mermaid Diagrams
settings.tui.resizeScrollback.descriptio: How a settled terminal resize refreshes transcript rows retained in terminal scrollback
settings.tui.resizeScrollback.label: Resize Scrollback
settings.tui.resizeScrollback.options.ap: Replay the transcript at the new width below retained history
settings.tui.resizeScrollback.options.pr: Repaint only the viewport and keep history wrapped at its old width
settings.tui.resizeScrollback.options.re: Erase all terminal scrollback, then replay one current-width transcript
settings.tui.scrollbackRebuild.descripti: Erase and replay terminal scrollback when a block
settings.tui.scrollbackRebuild.label: Rewrite Scrollback
settings.tui.textSizing.description: Render Markdown H1 headings at 2x scale using Kitty's OSC 66 text-sizing protocol. Only takes effect on Kitty terminals; ignored everywhere else. Off by default.
settings.tui.textSizing.label: Large Headings (Kitty)
settings.tui.tight.description: Remove the 1-character horizontal padding from the left and right of the terminal output
settings.tui.tight.label: Tight Layout
settings.tui.titleSpinner.description: Glyph set for the working-state spinner in the terminal title — braille sweep, filling moon, single-dot cycle, or ASCII-safe line
settings.tui.titleSpinner.label: Terminal Title Spinner
settings.tui.titleSpinner.options.line.d: ASCII - \ | / for fonts without braille coverage
settings.tui.titleState.description: Show the agent run state in the terminal title's separator — an animated spinner while working (a static ':' under WSL), '>' when it's your turn, '!' when the agent is waiting on you
settings.tui.titleState.label: Terminal Title Run State
settings.ui.compactThinkingLevel.descrip: Show the thinking level as a single icon on the model name instead of a separate ` · <level>` suffix.
settings.ui.compactThinkingLevel.label: Compact Thinking Level
